title: Twin Size Mattress Gel Memory Foam Bed Mattress in a Box Medium Firm and Good Support Removable and Washable Design Breathable Fabric Small Compression Packaging for Kids and Adults
features: Twin Size Memory Foam Mattress: The mattress is treated with gel, and the memory foam has good resilience, so this twin mattress has good support, can perfectly fit the body curve, and make people sleep more comfortable

Medium Firm Mattress Pressure Relief: Softness and hardness are important factors determining the comfort of a mattress. A mattress that is either too hard or too soft can cause physical discomfort. Choosing a medium firm mattress can find a balance between comfort and health

Twin Mattress in a Box: Mattress size 75 x 38 x 5 inch. Your mattress will be compressed, rolled, and in a compact box for easy delivery and move setup. Please allow at least 72 hours for your mattress to regain its full shape. Any memory foam will expand faster in a warmer room

No Fiberglass: Our twin size mattress is designed with fire-resistant fabric, which is safe and comfortable,This memory foam matress has passed CertiPUR US certification for durability and safety testing

Breathable and Soft Cover: The fabric of this twin mattress is smooth and comfortable, highly absorbent, allowing sweat to evaporate easily and keep your skin dry, Air vents in the top foam layer allow you to experience unprecedented refreshing sleep. which allows you and your family to have a comfortable and refreshing night's sleep.
